scope: UI feedback, static hosting preparation and private local companion; no research campaign or public deployment

versions.policy: UI and hosting release; original scientific editions and campaign runtime stay immutable. No metric or ranking changes.

limitations: Data-containing edition remains publication_authorized=false; obtain source-rights clearance through a reviewed successor edition before hosting.
Six historical preparation defects and three remaining source-specific reviews remain disclosed.
Historical complexity accounting is incomplete for at least 65 rules; primary metrics and provisional Pareto labels remain unchanged.
Windows support is not claimed; generated-code development workers require the supported macOS sandbox.
Private discovery requires installing and running the local companion; the public catalog does not execute visitor jobs.
Remaining methods, scientific contract review and independent novelty/value assessment remain separate research work.
